sources.title: Security Incident Recovery Update #3 — 90% replenished and ten top assets fully backed
claims: Binance states total stolen-asset replenishment reached 90%.
Binance states BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC are each 100% backed.
Binance states the remaining 10% consists of tokens outside the top ten and is less liquid.
Binance says it is using partial SAFU deployment, excess Futures Insurance Fund balance and corporate treasury; the Futures Insurance Fund remains above its required regulatory level.
Binance says a 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC PoR snapshot was taken and the full zero-knowledge proof is estimated by 2026-11-03 UTC.
Binance says withdrawals are targeted to resume Sunday 2026-11-01.
Binance says SAFU will be replenished to approximately USD 1B and is held/managed by Nest Clearing and Custody Limited, an ADGM FSRA-regulated recognized clearing house.
limitations: The 90% and 100%-backing figures are company claims pending independent verification through the full zero-knowledge proof.
The statement does not disclose an XRP-specific replenishment purchase quantity or transaction list.
The SAFU transfer destination and purpose are not specified in this announcement.
The 00:00 UTC PoR snapshot is not the same as a completed independently verifiable zero-knowledge proof.

sources.title: XRP Escrow Unlock Schedule — pinned XRPL ledger 108028302
claims: Two Ripple-owned escrow objects totaling 1B XRP have FinishAfter 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z at ledger 108028302, closed 2026-10-31T18:03Z.
Ripple-owned escrow totals 31.4B XRP across 98 objects and 8 accounts.
Prior 12 releases: 12B released, 8.4B re-escrowed (70%), 3.6B net outside escrow; median EscrowFinish delay 11 seconds, max 2.3 days.
October 2026: 1B released, 700M re-escrowed, 300M net.
limitations: Third-party derived public-rippled data, not a Ripple forecast.
FinishAfter eligibility is not proof of EscrowFinish, destination, exchange deposit or sale.

sources.title: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD

Deposits/withdrawals supported across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Ripple says it will provide Base liquidity.
Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral use is deferred, not live at launch.
limitations: Joint announcement, not independent evidence of volumes or net capital.
No chain-by-chain Coinbase balances or migration volume disclosed.
